name: Heroes Saga
source:
Welcome to Atris - a world of magic and intrigue, where outsiders are summoned through a mysterious ritual and called Heroes. But who are these Heroes, really? And what are they needed for? You’ll have to find out for yourself… if you survive.

You play as an ordinary guy who, by chance, finds himself in this world, on the continent of Valarion.
The locals mistake him for a newly summoned Hero, and every powerful figure seeks to use him for their own ends. To survive, he must adapt - making tough choices, trusting, deceiving, fighting, and winning! But remember: in this world, Heroes are merely tools. Those who become unwanted... quickly disappear.​

[From [url=https://feyada.itch.io/heroes-saga]itch.io[/url]]
